text: Paper and book atlas / 2013 Instability of Evaporation Fronts in the Interstellar Medium Jeong-Gyu Kim & Woong-Tae Kim · 2013 ApJ 779, 48 Reference listed · scope proposed Thermal conduction suppresses short-wavelength corrugations of CNM–WNM evaporation fronts. Linear stability analysis connects to nonlinear front deformation and enhanced evaporation. Scope in this archive. Detailed reconstruction of AppendixA with coupled eigenfunctions as the required output. Primary target: Figure9 temperature and transverse-velocity profiles from the same normalized mode; supporting targets are the background front, Figure5 dispersion and long-wave/cutoff limits. Source-audited plan only; no Kim eigenfunctions computed yet. Nonlinear2D remains separate and optional. Source review: arXiv1310.2940v2 Sections2–3 and AppendixA read; source pp3,5,6,9,14–16 visually checked. Constant conductivity1e5, m=1.37mH, five-component basis/order, Fourier phase and Figure9 normalizations recorded. Numerical reconstruction and source digitization pending.
